pl-l4d4c1-d1e115.summary: Distinguishes three cases: some receive the sacrament and the reality, some the sacrament but not the reality, some the reality but not the sacrament.
claims: Sacrament and reality can be received together or separately.

pl-l4d4c1-d1e118.summary: Holds that all infants receive sacrament and reality together, being cleansed of original sin in baptism. Some deny that sins are remitted to infants who will be lost, relying on Augustine's 'sacraments effect what they figure only in the elect', but misread it: sacraments effect remission in others too, but not unto salvation, which is only for the elect.
claims: All baptized infants receive remission of original sin.
Sacraments effect remission in all but salvation only in the elect.

pl-l4d4c1-d1e124.summary: Supports this with Augustine: from the newborn to the decrepit old man, none is barred from baptism and none fails to die to sin in it, infants to original sin only, adults to all they added, unless enormity of life prevents it. Adults baptized with faith also receive sacrament and reality.
claims: Baptism remits original sin in infants and all sin in adults.
Adults baptized with faith receive sacrament and reality.

pl-l4d4c1.summary: Distinguishes those who receive the sacrament and its reality, those who receive the sacrament without the reality, and those who receive the reality without the sacrament. All infants receive both, being cleansed of original sin in baptism, even those who will be lost; Augustine's 'sacraments effect what they figure only in the elect' means they effect it for salvation only in the elect. Augustine teaches that no one, from newborn to the very old, is barred from baptism, and none fails to die to sin in it. Adults who are baptized with faith also receive both.
claims: Some receive the sacrament and its reality, some only the sacrament, some only the reality.
All baptized infants receive the remission of original sin.
Sacraments effect salvation only in the elect, though they effect remission in others.
Adults baptized with faith receive both sacrament and reality.
